prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet", "Preparing your desktop pet... System environment and pet assets are being verified."]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet on your desktop screen. Click on it anytime to open pet options or hide/show controls."]
2: ["Confirm Pet Appearance", "Review your pet's custom features and traits before finalizing adoption."]
3: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Explore different starter paths below to find the best match for your workflow and desktop style."]
4: ["Press Alt+P or right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, hide, or send messages."]
5: ["Signing in syncs your account profile and restores any existing pets automatically."]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Upload 1-3 well-lit photos of your pet. Ensure clear lighting for best recognition."]
7: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet files are being configured. We're finalizing desktop integration."]
8: ["Select Your Journey", "Pick your companion's persona to get started instantly."]
9: ["Quick Desktop Pet Check", "Complete these quick steps to ensure your pet is fully visible and responsive on your screen."]
